name: openllm-orchestrator-cursor
description: Let any Cursor agent orchestrate OpenLLM for dashboard ops and real development tasks — models and gateway MCP in, GitHub/Vercel still yours.

OPENLLM_API_KEY.title: OpenLLM API key
OPENLLM_API_KEY.description: sk-llm / API key from the openllm.sh dashboard. Used only as ${OPENLLM_API_KEY} in mcp.json. Never commit the value.

OPENLLM_CLOUD_ORIGIN.title: OpenLLM cloud origin
OPENLLM_CLOUD_ORIGIN.description: Gateway origin the OpenLLM CLI MCP server talks to. Override only for a self-hosted or non-default origin.
